LESSON: READING FOR COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Reading 2.1 Reading Fluency (2 sessions) • Reading speed • Intonation • Particle
Topic 2.3: Reading for Comprehension

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading for Comprehension. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you extract specific information from a text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read a short text fluently and at a good pace
2. respond to questions from a text based on the theme
3. appreciate reading Arabic texts for enjoyment

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING FOR COMPREHENSION
This lesson teaches Reading for Comprehension for Grade 9 ARABIC.

STUDY STEPS
1. read a short text fluently and at a good pace
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. respond to questions from a text based on the theme
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate reading Arabic texts for enjoyment
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading for Comprehension using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading for Comprehension above.
2. Explain Reading for Comprehension to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading for Comprehension.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading for Comprehension with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading for Comprehension important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you extract specific information from a text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read a short text fluently and at a good pace
2. respond to questions from a text based on the theme
3. appreciate reading Arabic texts for enjoyment

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
